name: Server Tweaks - Discount SVM
teaser: A simple mod that contains some universal server config tweaks.
description_html:
This mod allows enabling some of the universally popular features from popular Server Value Modifier. It’s a deliberately small mod for those of us who don’t want everything SVM has.

Please keep in mind that some wanted features are not in the mod yet. I have not had enough time to research and implement them.

Image gallery

Here is what the config utility looks like. Use it before you run the server.

Logging
  • Enable Full Logging

Enable full logging in the server console

Hideout
  • Global Construction Time

Control how fast construction is

  • Remove Restrictions

Remove all cost for constructing

Raids
  • Enable Extended Duration

Whether Extra Exfiltration Time should be enabled

  • Extra Exfiltration Time

Extend every raid by X amount of minutes

  • Open Standard Exfils

Open all the exfils available to your character (does not affect paid/coop)

  • Cost for Coop Exfiltration

Set how much coop exfils cost (if Use Paid Coop Exfiltration is enabled)

  • Use Paid Coop Exfiltration

Convert coop exfils to paid exfils

Inventory
  • Weighted Armbands

Allow adjusting the weight of armbands (easy way for no weight)

  • Armband Weight

Set the weight of all armbands, if using weighted armbands

  • Lootable Melee

Allow looting melee from bots

  • Master Key

Whether Lose Items on Death is enabled

  • Lose Items on Death

Adjust what on your character can be lost on death

Traders
  • All Clothing is Free

Make the available clothing free of charge and available at level 1

Flea Market
  • Unlock Flea at Level 1

Whether to unlock the Flea Market on level 1.

Insurance
  • Insurance on Labs

Enable insurance on Laboratory

  • Guaranteed Return for Prapor

Whether Prapor’s insurance is guaranteed to return

  • Guaranteed Return for Therapist

Whether Therapist’s insurance is guaranteed to return

  • Insurance Max Storage Time

How long insurance can be stored before going MIA

  • When Should Insurance Return

How long until insurance can return
